assertions.name: sweep_ran_to_completion
assertions.source: The Phase 3 sweep must either emit new (K, λ, A) cells or be a no-op re-run with --merge-existing (in which case all expected cells were already in the catalogue).

description: Phase 3 production isotope sweep (max-A=4). Builds derived (K, λ, A) cells for every production isotope × every Wedderburn partition via pyhecke_native.chi_q_via_gp. Kauffman convention t = q² natively.
